notes: Phase 27 meets its acceptance criteria in the actual code: allowlisted bounded SSH templates with validated positional args and double redaction, a lock-guarded collector with bounded tick/prune and ids-only logs and activity, metrics/status/logs/graph APIs behind strict Zod output schemas with named 400/404/422/502 errors, HMAC-bound opaque log cursors, capped follow streams that close their SSH session, and nine real-fault integration cases whose stored evidence ranks the expected diagnosis first; unit/typecheck/lint/boundaries re-run green here (9797 tests) and the it-* gates are cached green after the last commit. Findings below are non-blocking follow-ups. | findings: 27-02 A1 (edge, non-default config): createDeployConnect (apps/control-plane/src/deploy/deploy-connect.ts:49) ignores the AbortSignal, so the tick deadline only aborts the probes, not the SSH connect; a tick can overrun by up to NOODARA_SSH_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS per lane, and with a connect timeout above the 30 s LOCK_MARGIN_MS (collector-runtime.ts:29) the Redis tick lock could expire before the tick ends. Default (10 s) is safe; the unit test proves the deadline only with a signal-aware fake connect. Follow-up: honour the signal in the connect or size the lock margin from connectMs.; 27-02 A2 (semantics): an unreachable server is recorded only in the tick summary/log; servers.status stays CONNECTED and only last_seen_at goes stale. The server metrics API exposes lastSeenAt so staleness is derivable (documented in .planning/DECISIONS.md, 1.5 intervals), but connectionState keeps reporting CONNECTED for a dead host; 28/29 should either persist UNREACHABLE via the state machine or add a server-side stale flag.; 27-02 H1 (race, low impact): 'connection held by a deploy' is a check-then-act DB lookup (collector-store.ts:24-34, non-terminal deployment or proxy INSTALLING), not a mutex; a deploy starting mid-tick shares the host with the collector session, and service stop/restart jobs are not counted as busy. Self-overlap of ticks is correctly prevented (SET NX PX + in-process flag).; 27-02 H2 (coverage): the integration 'H2' case writes a parse-error observation through writeServerTick directly; the real one-bad-container salvage path is covered only by unit tests with a mocked probe. A whole-probe failure (timeout/oversize) drops all containers with a warn and no per-container observation error.; 27-02 A4 (coverage): the simulated-week retention test inserts rows directly and never fills container_metric_samples, so pruning of that table is unproven at integration level; the observation prune runs NOT IN (DISTINCT ON ...) per batch (cost, not correctness).; 27-06 A2 (weak record): surfaces are recorded per diagnosis, in memory only, and one surface per diagnosis suffices; EVIDENCE_SURFACES in diagnosis-evidence.ts is the durable artifact that 28-03 can consume. high_disk uses a tmpfs over DockerRootDir and server_unreachable derives staleness client-side from lastSeenAt, both documented in DECISIONS.md.; 27-03 (minor): memory_percent for historical buckets uses the current host total; the SQL lower bound is the aligned bucket start rather than the requested from; a malformed path UUID returns the generic VALIDATION_FAILED instead of METRICS_QUERY_INVALID (still a 400).; 27-05 (minor): the node cap is applied after loading every row of the scope (no SQL LIMIT) and the REPEATABLE READ/READ ONLY isolation is asserted by no test; ids over 128 chars hit the generic VALIDATION_FAILED instead of GRAPH_QUERY_INVALID.; Process: plan.json still lists 27-06 as active although gate-cache.json records its gates green at 2026-11-04T21:05Z (after the last commit e9768d51 at 20:54Z); the orchestrator must still advance it. Untracked docs/ui-build-prompt.md is outside the phase scope and uncommitted (not part of the phase diff).
